frequency_question: What proportion of such efforts achieve operational status within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes state-level programs attempting to build licensed or reverse-engineered production lines for foreign air-launched cruise missiles or equivalent precision-guided standoff munitions during an active conflict. Excludes simple maintenance depots, minor refurbishment facilities, or non-missile munitions like artillery shells.

cases.name: Ukrainian domestic Neptune cruise missile serial production initiation
Taiwanese Hsiung Feng III scaled-up domestic production acceleration
Pakistani Babur cruise missile domestic manufacturing establishment

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; universe of direct Western cruise missile transfers for local production is extremely sparse.
known_gaps: Extremely few exact precedents exist for transferring complex French/British storm shadow manufacturing due to proprietary intellectual property and specialized microelectronics supply chains.
skeleton: Cases represent verified major missile domestic production establishment programs under high-pressure security environments.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 closely analogous historical major domestic missile establishment programs yields a high baseline frequency, adjusted downward for extreme technological dependency on Western subcomponents.
validity_reason: Based on long-term defense industrial base adaptation timelines which remain stable across multi-year intervals.
